title: Ubukyak Afal Yomcowwe Migaq
intro: mango liggiditteh qammaalaanamak lakal qilsi xaaqo kibbimteh tan tibbale arac taswiir. Ambullee waytaamak, dumah akah yeceenih yanin migaq quukak, dumaahi sanatak xabba haanam qilmi kee manoh giclo, racmatta kee saytunnos wagsiisak xagana culak geytima.
clues: Anu oobokem afal Yalli isih muggaaqiseh suge, yok afal numuh yoh aceeween migaq luk.
anu gacsah yomcowweh suge idaltuh yan xaleenak xaylo takkem duude waytaamak iroh yascubeenim.
Anu qunxuk suge way waleey, cokmi kee kutbe yomcowweh suge.
Anu inni xaltanih dirki luk sugeeh, gersi marah racmatta luk sugeeh, kaxxiina akkek ammirtimak masugiyyo.
Yalli salaam yoh madqisem anu elle ooboke ayroay, elle rabe ayrooy, manol elle ugte ayro.
Yi abba Zakariyya, salaatah (mihrab) aracal soolak suge wak, malaykootak rufto le xaagu yoh geeh.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
